text: My cabin: C-73. Ring the bell by the door to call Smethells.
The trunk key is in my bag on the bed.
My trunk: a cryptograph for German codes and a report on the international situation.
Penny Pringle: cabin F-34, F deck. Use the second-class stairs.
The Purser can give any passenger's cabin number. Office: left, before the C deck cabins.
Lifts: behind the forward Grand Staircase.
The Burnses: cabin C-78. Mr. Burns has a darkroom there; look at his pictures.
Mr. Barbicon: cabin A-14. Vlad wants his package; say you come from Vlad.
Mr. and Mrs. Conkling: cabin B-59.
Lord and Lady Georgia: stateroom B-70.
Colonel Zeitel: cabin C-59.
Shailagh Hacker: third class, cabin F-59, forward.
Mr. Trask: cabin D-33.
Daisy Cashmore: cabin A-25.
The Gorse-Joneses: cabin A-19.
Mr. Siedlemann: cabin A-10.
Claris Limehouse and her mother: cabin D-19, near Reception.
Reverend Troutt: second class, cabin F-32.
Buick Riviera is never in his cabin; he gambles in the smoking room.
Charles gave the real necklace to Sasha. It's in Sasha's cabin.
Willie hid a notebook somewhere on board.
At Queenstown Willie was seen at the top of the last smokestack, hiding something.
The only way into the smokestack is through the engine room.
A motorcar is in the cargo hold. Whoever shows the car keys is let through.
Cargo room: forward past the Well deck, under the Forecastle deck.
The Purser's cargo manifest shows where the crate is. He may have keys to the hold.
Get into the wireless room and intercept Zeitel's telegrams.
Wireless room: boat deck, port side, just astern of the bridge.
Leave the Rubaiyat with the Purser for safekeeping.
Something's up at the Turkish bath.
Willie Haderlitz is dead, electrocuted in the Turkish bath.
Trask: the pipe has been somewhere humid. Steam up the Turkish bath.
Trask: read the full verse; completing it gives the answer.
Squash court: entrance on D deck. Willie waits there.
Gymnasium: boat deck, starboard side.
Café Parisien: aft past the B deck cabins, at the aft Grand Stair landing.
A deck has been complaining about the lights; Alex is seeing to the fusebox.
Conkling: meet Shailagh on the poop deck in his place. No trouble if she returns the letter.
The Purser wants a message taken to the wireless room.
Penny thinks Zeitel hid the notebook in his cabin, C-59.
Zeitel will trade the antidote for the painting.
Zeitel: Lady Georgia is in Sasha's cabin, A-14.
Lady Georgia: meet her on the boat deck, with the necklace.
Claris Limehouse is in the First-Class lounge.
